title: Novel Snapshot-Based Hyperspectral Conversion for Dermatological Lesion Detection via YOLO Object Detection Models
summary: SAVE-transformed images combined with YOLO detectors improved classification of three lesion classes against white-light images on a held-out ISIC image set. It is a public-image diagnostic benchmark, not clinical screening validation.
ai_technology: Methods report 2,203 ISIC images and 70/20/10 split; Results compare WLI and SAVE across five YOLO variants.
organization: Zuoying Armed Forces General Hospital; I-Shou University

evidence.tested: SAVE-transformed images combined with YOLO detectors improved classification of three lesion classes against white-light images on a held-out ISIC image set. It is a public-image diagnostic benchmark, not clinical screening validation.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported dataset, experimental setting and validation in this study; broader generalization and real-world benefit are not established.
